key_insight: OptScientist discovers compact symbolic optimization laws that explain observations as outcomes of underlying optimization problems.
engineering_relevance: The framework could help engineers infer interpretable objectives and constraints from observed system behavior.
method: Learn to represent observed data as an optimization problem, then extract its symbolic form.
Use an LLM agent to integrate scientific priors and discover candidate laws.
Abstract candidate mechanisms and suggest new data to collect.
evidence_signal: On the 99-problem OptFeynman benchmark, OptScientist recovers over 80% of ground-truth laws; on risky choice and monetary policy, it achieves competitive held-out prediction with few parameters.
watch_item: Predictive accuracy alone does not establish that a discovered objective or constraint is the true mechanism generating the data.
paper_title: OptScientist: Automated Discovery of Optimization Laws
